name: Bank of India
about: Bank of India is an India-based bank. The Bank's segments include Treasury Operations, Wholesale Banking and Retail Banking. The Treasury operations segment includes the entire investment portfolio, which is dealing in government and other securities, money market operations and foreign exchange operations.(Source : Company Web-site )
keyPoints:
Market Position 
The bank ranks as the sixth-largest nationalized bank in India, with advances of Rs. 5.85 lakh Cr and a total business (Advances + Deposits) of Rs. 13.24 lakh Cr as of FY24.[1] [2]

pros: Stock is trading at 0.79 times its book value
Company has delivered good profit growth of 38.1% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 20.0%
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 9.81% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
